example_validation: Each listed clause was re-parsed against the current offline CardDB and is still ignored on a partial card.
ranking_method: Implementation priority from the proposed capability roadmap; separate from measured coarse family rankings. No per-task gain forecast.
inclusion_rule: Only residual ignored clauses on partial cards. Full cards, matched portions of partial cards, and simplification-only cards are excluded.

examples: A Display of My Dark Power

items.title: Filtered entry/death triggers
items.remaining_scope: Extend trigger subjects to remaining nontoken, power-bound, and grouped-entry predicates; preserve once-per-turn and optional-payment behavior.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Whenever another nontoken creature dies, you may draw a card.
Whenever one or more other creatures you control with power 2 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, you may pay {1}. If you do, draw a card.

items.title: Quoted activated abilities
items.remaining_scope: Attach parsed activated or mana abilities to the correct recipient; handle team grants, activation costs, source removal, and ability loss.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Enchanted land has "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
All Slivers have "{2}, Sacrifice ~: ~ deals 2 damage to any target."

items.title: Variable amounts and X effects
items.remaining_scope: Resolve missing X definitions from board state and graveyard counts at the specified time, including entry counters and stat changes.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the highest mana value among permanents you control.
~ enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in all graveyards.

items.title: Relationships between multiple targets
items.remaining_scope: Validate distinct recipients and shared-controller relationships; choose a counter quantity and move it without duplication.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Move any number of +1/+1 counters from target creature onto another target creature with the same controller.
{1}{G}: Move a +1/+1 counter from target creature onto another target creature with the same controller.

items.title: Additional delayed-effect durations
items.remaining_scope: Compose the remaining exile/return wording with exact-card identity and next-end-step scheduling, including creature-or-artifact targets.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: {1}{W}{U}: Exile another target creature or artifact you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

items.title: Graveyard target filters
items.remaining_scope: Add the remaining exact-mana-value graveyard predicate while preserving card identity and resolution-time legality.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: • Return target creature card with mana value 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.

items.title: Subtype-based sacrifice costs
items.remaining_scope: Select and reserve a legal creature of the required subtype when paying a sacrifice cost; retain transactional payment behavior.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: {1}{R}, Sacrifice a Goblin: ~ deals 4 damage to target creature.

items.title: Token-granted abilities
items.remaining_scope: Parse remaining named-token bodies with quoted triggered abilities and bind self references to each token, including later counters.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: [−4]: Create a 2/2 white Cat Soldier creature token named ~'s Pridemate with "Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on ~."

items.title: Aura attachment and movement
items.remaining_scope: Move existing Auras between permanents while enforcing attachment legality, controller relationships, and the printed all-Auras scope.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: attach all Auras enchanting target permanent to another permanent with the same controller.
{1}{U}: Attach target Aura attached to a permanent to another permanent with the same controller.

items.title: Combat and casting restrictions
items.remaining_scope: Apply remaining combat-wide attacker/blocker limits and timed player casting/nonmana-activation restrictions in the action legality paths.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: No more than one creature can attack each combat.
No more than one creature can block each combat.
Until end of turn, target player can't cast instant or sorcery spells, and that player can't activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
